pairs.registryProposal: The standard combines general action-combat pacing techniques (intensity-threat tension curves, beat taxonomy, duration envelopes, fight report cards) with multi-entrant combat racing opening gates (lead-car lap-one elimination rate and division-wide damage multipliers) whose preconditions do not hold for standard ARPG combat encounters; segregating vehicle combat racing into a distinct sub-module would sharpen registry applicability.

pairs.registryProposal: The standard requires fight report cards to present dramatic beat findings alongside outcome bands, but does not provide an aggregation specification for reporting beat distributions across large Monte Carlo sample sets.
